rules.statement: A party to a partition action who has been brought into substitute a deceased original defendant, who has failed and neglected to file a statement of claim or even a proxy despite notice/summons being served on such defendant, cannot be permitted to file fresh pleadings nearly 24 years after the institution of the action when the said action has reached the stage envisaged in section 184 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: I answer that question in the negative.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 184 of the Civil Procedure Code
